name: release.feed
description: Foundation-issued, FALCON-1024 signed HyperMesh release announcement. Each entry is published by the foundation as a Catalog asset; subscribing daemons validate the FALCON-1024 signature against the configured foundation pubkey and update their local available_versions cache. Version selection is per-channel (stable/beta/nightly).

version.description: Semver version string for this release (e.g. '0.2.0', '1.0.0-rc1').

binary_hashes.description: Per-target SHA-256 hashes of distributed binaries, keyed by Rust target triple (e.g., {"x86_64-unknown-linux-musl": "<sha256 hex>"}).

release_notes_url.description: URL to release notes (clearnet HTTPS or HyperMesh DNS asset URL).

signed_by.description: FALCON-1024 public key bytes of the foundation signer, hex-encoded.

signature.description: FALCON-1024 detached signature over the canonical signing_payload.

requires_min_version.description: Optional: oldest client version that can upgrade directly to this release. Clients on older versions need to chain through an intermediate version.

breaking_changes.description: If true, this release is incompatible with prior protocol_version. Clients must opt in explicitly.

issued_at.description: When the foundation signed this release entry.

verification.signing_payload_format: [version UTF-8] || 0x00 || [channel UTF-8] || 0x00 || [canonical(binary_hashes) UTF-8] || 0x00 || [issued_at u64 LE seconds]
verification.binary_hashes_canonical: JSON object with keys sorted lexicographically and no whitespace (canonical JSON)
verification.verification_key: Foundation root pubkey configured at the daemon (DaemonState.release_feed_subscriber.foundation_pubkey)
